message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: CI

on:
  pull_request:
    types:
      - opened
      - synchronize
      - reopened
      - ready_for_review
    branches:
      - main

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  code-check:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Install Node dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install uv and set up Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          enable-cache: false
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Run pre-commit hooks
        uses: pre-commit/action@v3.0.1

  pytest-linux:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false
    permissions:
      contents: read
    strategy:
        matrix:
            python-version: ["3.12", "3.13"]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Install uv and set up Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: uv sync --no-dev --all-extras

      - name: Start Ollama server
        run: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh && ollama serve &

      - name: Test with pytest
        run: uv run pytest
        env:
          HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          XAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.XAI_API_KEY }}

      - name: Delete EuroEval cache
        run: rm -rf .euroeval_cache

  pytest-macos:
    if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false && contains(github.event.pull_request.labels.*.name, 'macos')
    permissions:
      contents: read
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - name: Install uv and set up Python
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          enable-cache: true
          python-version: ${{ matrix.python-version }}

      - name: Install Dependencies
        run: uv sync --no-dev --all-extras

      - name: Start Ollama server
        run: curl -fsSL https://ollama.com/install.sh | sh && ollama serve &

      - name: Test with pytest
        run: uv run pytest -vvv
        env:
          HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY }}
          HF_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.HUGGINGFACE_API_KEY }}
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GEMINI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GEMINI_API_KEY }}
          XAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.XAI_API_KEY }}

      - name: Delete EuroEval cache
        run: rm -rf .euroeval_cache
",
  "rationale": "Enable uv's built-in dependency caching (P-LIT-GHA-CACHE / P-LIT-DISTRIBUTED-CACHE) by changing `enable-cache: false` to `enable-cache: true` in both pytest-linux and pytest-macos jobs. The repository uses uv.lock for pinned dependencies, satisfying the cache key precondition. Experimental evidence (batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2) shows ~9% elapsed time savings from caching Python dependencies in a similar workflow. The setup-uv action handles cache key generation from lockfiles automatically. No other changes are made to preserve test coverage and behavior.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-hiruni-pattern-bat-ae496965ffa682a2-r2", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}
